# Consulting Farms

> Consulting Farms FZ-LLC is a Dubai-based mushroom farm and agricultural consultancy. It grows fresh mushrooms in its own grow rooms and helps farmers in the UAE set up and run mushroom farms, greenhouses and hydroponic / vertical farming systems.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Consulting Farms FZ-LLC
- Office: Office 1205, Al Manara Tower, Business Bay, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 55 420 0786
- Email: consultingfarms@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Gulf Standard Time)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/consulting_farms786/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@consultingfarms

## Products
- Button mushrooms (white & brown), fresh
- Oyster mushrooms, fresh
- Specialty mushrooms (seasonal)
- Greenhouse & hydroponic leafy greens

## Services
- Mushroom farm setup
- Grow-room design
- Planting warehouse & substrate preparation
- Greenhouse management (ventilation, shading, cooling, irrigation, hygiene)
- Hydroponic & vertical farming
- Crop advisory & grower training
- Wholesale & business supply (restaurants, hotels, retailers, distributors)
